hook: Your map shows Australia is wider than the Moon.
title: Australia Is Wider Than the Moon
description:
Australia is about 4,000 km from east to west. The Moon is about 3,474 km across. So the whole Moon would fit inside the width of one country.

#Shorts #Australia #MoonFacts
comment_prompt: Did you know this? Yes or no
